final_draft.answer: Yes, for employees. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor. Our Access Control Policy also says that all workforce members must authenticate with a second factor.
final_draft.note: This is only a partial match. The approved answer covers employees only and does not mention contractors. Access Control Policy section 4.2 requires a second factor for 'all workforce members', but none of the sources I found defines 'workforce member' or says whether it includes contractors. So I did not say directly that contractors are covered. A policy owner should confirm whether contractors count as workforce members before the answer is changed to name them. I also didn't run a live check, because none of the available checks covers sign-in to the identity provider. The GitHub organisation two-factor check covers GitHub only.
